name: TightVNC
description: The bare-bones, free, open-source VNC implementation — the RFB protocol as-is, with no cloud layer, no account system, and no modern security bolted on. Still actively maintained, but functionally frozen in the VNC's original spirit.

Wayland Unattended Access.comment: Requires X11; not compatible with Wayland sessions out of the box

Tailscale Support.comment: No native integration; works over any reachable network incl. a VPN like Tailscale

Microphone Passthrough.comment: The RFB protocol has no built-in audio channel at all

Adaptive Bitrate.comment: Tight encoding adjusts JPEG quality/compression level, but it's manual/basic compared to modern ABR

H.264 Codec.comment: Uses pixel encodings (Tight/Hextile), not video codecs

Multi-User Sessions.comment: Attaches to one existing desktop session, no isolated multi-user session support

4:4:4 Chroma Subsampling.comment: Raw/Hextile encodings are lossless; Tight encoding can drop to lossy JPEG at lower quality settings

Frame Rate (FPS).comment: Pixel-diffing protocol, not a fixed-FPS video pipeline

Pre-Login Access.comment: Possible on Windows if the server is installed and run as a system service

No Account Required.comment: Just an IP address and a password; no account or cloud registration at all

2FA / MFA.comment: Only a single static password; no two-factor authentication support

Windows: Host.comment: The most mature and commonly used platform for TightVNC

macOS: Host.comment: No official TightVNC server build for macOS

macOS: Client.comment: Third-party/generic VNC viewers can connect, no dedicated official TightVNC macOS client

Android: Client.comment: Generic third-party VNC viewer apps work, no official TightVNC Android app

iOS: Client.comment: Generic third-party VNC viewer apps work, no official TightVNC iOS app

Web Browser: Client.comment: No native browser client; the separate noVNC project can be paired with it manually

Free Tier.comment: Entirely free, no paid tiers exist at all

Enterprise.comment: No enterprise SKU, licensing, or management console — same free build for everyone
